headlines.title: Is Airbnb (ABNB) Still Undervalued On Growth Hopes And Its American Express Deal?
headlines.summary: Airbnb (ABNB) is back in focus after analysts flagged projected year-over-year gains in upcoming quarterly results, as the company rolls out guest-friendly rule changes and deepens distribution through a new American Express partnership. Recent trading shows that Airbnb’s share price has built solid upward momentum over 2026, with a year to date share price return of 25.52% and a 1 year total shareholder return of 36.29%. This comes even though the stock slipped 2.43% on the day to US$166.

headlines.title: EQUINOX ANNOUNCES HOUSE OF EQUINOX, AN IMMERSIVE EXPLORATION OF ALIVENESS
headlines.summary: Equinox, the authority in high-performance luxury lifestyle, announces House of Equinox, an immersive wellness experience presented by American Express at Thirty-Five Off Madison in New York City from November 12–15, 2026. The experience, exclusively available to eligible American Express Card Members through the Premium Events Collection™, is designed to explore what it truly means to feel alive, discovering the connection between physical energy, emotional vitality, and human connection.

headlines.title: American Express Draws Bill Ackman’s Warning: “I would be concerned.” What the Estimates Price In
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysBill Ackman said on CNBC’s Squawk Pod that if he were at American Express, he’d be concerned about Ramp, a private fintech valued at $60 billion in October. Analysts still expect American Express’s normalized EPS to grow at a double-digit pace through 2028, with revenue up 9% to 10% a year.

headlines.title: American Express Is Down 12% in 2026. What Its Latest Quarter Says About the Rebound
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysAmerican Express is down 12% in 2026 but up 7. 5% in the past month.

headlines.title: American Express (AXP) Brings Global Basketball Perks To Card Holders Worldwide
headlines.summary: American Express (NYSE:AXP) announced a major global expansion of its NBA, WNBA, and USA Basketball partnerships, adding new international activations. The broadened agreement introduces first-time overseas fan programs and card member experiences linked to league events and USA Basketball activities. New card holder perks include in-game access, tailored merchandise benefits, and exclusive offers around marquee basketball events worldwide.

description: American Express Company, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an integrated payments company in the United States, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, the Asia Pacific, Australia, New Zealand, Latin America, Canada, the Caribbean, and internationally. It operates through four segments: U.S. Consumer Services, Commercial Services, International Card Services, and Global Merchant and Network Services. The company offers credit and charge cards and complementary products and services, including travel, dining, and lifestyle and expense management products and services; and banking and other payment and financing products and services, including deposits and non-card lending. It also provides merchant acquisition and processing, servicing and settlement, fraud prevention, and point-of-sale marketing and information products and services, as well as network services. The company offers its products and services to consumers, small businesses, mid-sized companies, and large corporations through mobile and online applications, affiliate marketing, customer referral programs, third-party service providers and business partners, in-house sales teams, direct mail, telephone, and direct response advertising. American Express Company was founded in 1850 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
